q1.explanationZh: burst 不规则动词，过去式和过去分词都是 burst；burst into tears“突然哭起来”。

q2.explanationZh: bury“掩埋”，注意 u 读作 /e/；过去式 buried，变 y 为 i 加 -ed。

q3.explanationZh: bus“公共汽车”，复数 buses；bus stop“公交站”。

q4.explanationZh: bush“灌木（丛）”，a thick bush“茂密的灌木丛”。

q5.explanationZh: business 由 busy 变 y 为 i 加 -ness 构成，意为“商业；生意”。

q6.explanationZh: busy 形容词“忙的”，注意 u 读作 /ɪ/。

q7.explanationZh: but 是连词“但是”，表示转折。

q8.explanationZh: butcher“屠夫；肉食品商”，注意 u 读作 /ʊ/。

q9.explanationZh: butter 名词“黄油”，也可作动词“涂黄油于”：butter the bread。

q11.explanationZh: button“纽扣；按钮”，中间是双写的 tt。

q12.explanationZh: buy“购买；换取”，过去式和过去分词是 bought。

q13.explanationZh: by 作介词可表示“在……旁边；被；用（某种方式）”，如 by underground“乘地铁”；作副词表示“经过”。

q14.explanationZh: bye 是感叹词“再见”，与 by 同音，注意末尾的 e。

q15.explanationZh: cabbage“卷心菜”，中间双写 bb，结尾 -age 读 /ɪdʒ/。

q17.explanationZh: cable 名词“电缆”，作定语表示“有线电视的”：a cable station。

q18.explanationZh: café“咖啡馆”，词尾的 é 读 /eɪ/。

q19.explanationZh: cafeteria“自助餐馆（或食堂）”，重音在 -te- 上。

q21.explanationZh: cake“蛋糕”，a 读 /eɪ/，以不发音的 e 结尾。

q22.explanationZh: calculate“计算；估计”，名词计算器是 calculator。

q23.explanationZh: calculate 去 e 加 -or 构成 calculator“计算器”。

q25.explanationZh: call 可作动词“喊；打电话给；把……叫做；拜访”，也可作名词“（一次）电话”。

q26.explanationZh: calligraphy“书法”，注意双写 ll 和结尾的 -graphy（书写）。

q27.explanationZh: calm 可作形容词、名词和动词，表示“平静（的）；镇定”，其中 l 不发音。

q31.explanationZh: camp 名词“营地；野营”，动词“宿营”；summer camp“夏令营”。

q32.explanationZh: campaign“战役；运动；竞选”，注意结尾的 -aign，g 不发音。

q33.explanationZh: burst into“突然……起来”，如 burst into tears“突然哭起来”。

q34.explanationZh: call on sb.“拜访某人”；call on/upon sb. to do“号召某人做某事”。

q35.explanationZh: call off“取消”，如 call off the match“取消比赛”。

q36.explanationZh: call in 表示“顺路拜访”，也表示“请来某人（帮助处理）”。

q38.explanationZh: call at + 地点“访问某地”，call on + 人“拜访某人”。

q39.explanationZh: by accident“意外地；偶然”，相当于 by chance。

q40.explanationZh: by all means“一定；当然可以”，注意与 by no means“决不”区分。

q41.explanationZh: by comparison“比较起来，相比之下”。

q42.explanationZh: by means of“用，依靠（某种方法）”，后接名词。

q44.explanationZh: by no means“决不”，放句首时句子要部分倒装。

q45.explanationZh: by the + 计量单位表示“按……计”，by the dozen“按打计”。

q46.explanationZh: by this means“用这种方法”，means 单复数同形。

q47.explanationZh: by contrast 和 in contrast 都表示“对比之下”。

q48.explanationZh: “淮海战役”是专有名词，Huaihai Campaign 中 campaign 意为“战役”，首字母大写。

q49.explanationZh: “猎人在山顶附近宿营”，camp 作动词“宿营”，叙述过去的事用过去式 camped。

q50.explanationZh: “用公式计算容器的容积”，to 后接动词原形 calculate。

q51.explanationZh: “护士们使焦虑的病人平静下来”，calm 作动词“使平静”，用过去式 calmed。

q52.explanationZh: “排长队买音乐会的票”，to 后接动词原形 buy。

q53.explanationZh: by the + 计量单位表示“按……计”：by the pound“按磅”，by the yard“按码”，by the dozen“按打”。

q54.explanationZh: keep calm“保持冷静”，keep 后接形容词作表语。

q55.explanationZh: call off“取消”，“天气恶化，他们取消了搜救”，用过去式 called。

q56.explanationZh: 把老虎放回“笼子”里，cage“笼子”，its 后接名词单数。

q57.explanationZh: “现在照相机不贵，年轻人都买得起”，a 后接可数名词单数 camera。

q58.sampleAnswer: He returned the umbrella he had taken by mistake.
references: He returned the umbrella he had taken by mistake.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “拿错”= take sth. by mistake；“拿错”发生在“放回”之前，用过去完成时 had taken。

q59.sampleAnswer: The proposal for planting organic cabbages must be submitted by next Thursday.
references: The proposal for planting organic cabbages must be submitted by next Thursday.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: cabbage 泛指时用复数 cabbages；“方案被提交”用被动语态 must be submitted，“在……之前”用 by。

q60.sampleAnswer: She almost failed in the exam, but her sister, by contrast, did very well.
references: She almost failed in the exam, but her sister, by contrast, did very well.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “相比之下”= by contrast，可作插入语，前后用逗号隔开。

q61.sampleAnswer: She constantly tries to employ calligraphy in the design of Peking Opera costumes.
references: She constantly tries to employ calligraphy in the design of Peking Opera costumes.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “书法”= calligraphy；“将……融入……”可用 employ sth. in...；“京剧”= Peking Opera。

q62.sampleAnswer: There is nothing more rewarding for a comedian than hearing the audience burst into laughter during a show.
references: There is nothing more rewarding for a comedian than hearing the audience burst into laughter during a show.
There is nothing more rewarding for a comedian than hearing a burst of laughter from the audience during a show.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “阵阵笑声”可用 burst into laughter（hear sb. do sth.）或 a burst of laughter；“没有什么比……更……”= nothing + 比较级 + than。

q63.sampleAnswer: Since taking office, the town mayor has always regarded understanding people’s livelihood and listening to public opinions as his top priority, and called on every household in his spare time.
references: Since taking office, the town mayor has always regarded understanding people’s livelihood and listening to public opinions as his top priority, and called on every household in his spare time.
Since taking office, the town mayor has always considered understanding people’s livelihood and listening to public opinions as his top priority, and called on every household in his spare time.
Since taking office, the town mayor has always regarded understanding people’s livelihood and listening to public opinions as his first priority, and called on every household in his spare time.
Since taking office, the town mayor has always considered understanding people’s livelihood and listening to public opinions as his first priority, and called on every household in his spare time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “走访”= call on sb.；“把……视为……”= regard/consider... as...；since 引导的时间状语常与现在完成时连用。

q64.sampleAnswer: However busy we are, we should regularly spend some time talking with our parents.
references: However busy we are, we should regularly spend some time talking with our parents.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “无论多忙”= however busy we are（however + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语）；spend time (in) doing sth.“花时间做某事”。

q65.sampleAnswer: When I see the picture, it always reminds me of the happy time I spent in the summer camp.
references: When I see the picture, it always reminds me of the happy time I spent in the summer camp.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “夏令营”= summer camp；“使某人想起……”= remind sb. of sth.。

q66.sampleAnswer: The purpose of motivating children to read lies not in the number of books but in the cultivation of their love for reading.
references: The purpose of motivating children to read lies not in the number of books but in the cultivation of their love for reading.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “不在于……而在于……”= lie not in... but in...，but 连接两个并列的介词短语。

q67.sampleAnswer: Not all the graduates from key universities are necessarily fit for starting their own business, which involves sharp market sense and good opportunities.
references: Not all the graduates from key universities are necessarily fit for starting their own business, which involves sharp market sense and good opportunities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “自主创业”= start one’s own business；“不一定都”是部分否定，用 not all... necessarily；which 引导非限制性定语从句。
